caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition on a beige, textured background. At the top, there is a stylized cross with pointed ends, outlined in red and filled with shades of gold and blue, with blue accents in the center of each arm. Below the cross, there are two wing-like shapes in gold with red tips, extending outward from either side. Between the wings is a bow-like shape composed of four elongated loops outlined in blue and filled with gold and red dots, with a blue circle at the center featuring a small gold star. Beneath these elements is a large, ornate circular medallion, outlined in red, with an intricate pattern of radiating shapes in blue and gold. The medallion contains several layers of geometric and floral motifs, all rendered in harmonious combinations of gold, red, and blue, echoing the colors used throughout the drawing.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
